directive: Authorise staged autonomous local model review workers, starting Achilles, with Achilles oversight of further existing Z-stack roles when independently qualified.

separation.Achilles: independent owner/risk review, not Neo execution
separation.Neo: EMASSC/LS.cgx engineering child; no replaced master
separation.UniSpace: permissioned R3 consumer, not authority root
separation.Smith: existing single-consumer queue only, no duplicate or stale-lock bypass

activation_order: Achilles first, then one role at a time after independent acceptance of its review-only tests and current resource/singleton evidence; 14 roles are not 14 resident processes.
progress_protocol: Four bounded source-verified implementation/integration advances followed by one independent negative review; batch dependencies before isolated debugging, never substitute a pass for native proof.
permitted_scope: private local Ollama inference from permissioned source-grade metadata
private source-only test proposals and isolated non-effectful tests
non-destructive review branch source changes after actual connector authority and commit readback
blocked_effects: Smith lease recovery by lock deletion
model weight training without separate rights/approval
promotion_guard: Current signed issuer, revocation, DBR, lease, scoped permission, negative tests and independent readback are mandatory for effectful native operation; no local model text creates authority.
